name: refined-plex
title: Refined, in IBM Plex Sans
note: Refined with a different face for interface text, to compare.

mint-50.why: a pale tint of mint, a selected row or a success message

red-800.why: a shade of red-ink, a destructive button under the pointer

red-900.why: a shade of red-ink, a destructive button pressed

red-50.why: a pale tint of red, behind an error message

amber-50.why: warning background; the site has no warning colour

mint-wash.why: a greyed tint of mint, for a success message or a selected row on paper: mint-50 is far brighter than the deep green that does this job in dark

amber-wash.why: a greyed tint of amber, for a warning on paper

red-wash.why: a greyed tint of red, for an error message on paper

paper-200.why: a shade of paper, for bands, tinted rows and tracks: stone-100 is a 3% step on paper and reads green beside it

mint-soft.why: mint with its saturation taken down, behind a tick or a switch key on paper: full mint reads much louder in light than its dark counterpart

red-950.why: a deep shade of red-ink, an opaque error surface on dark

amber-950.why: a deep shade of the warning colour, an opaque warning surface on dark
